name: Meet Widget
description:
Never be late for a call again. Meet Widget keeps your next Google Calendar meeting in the top bar and gets you into the call with one click.

• Always know what's next: "Design critique · in 5 min", "25 min left" or "Free 40 min" right in the top bar. Choose smart, countdown or status mode. The button pulses when it's time to join.
• Your whole day in one click: past meetings fade out, the current one is highlighted, free slots, overlaps and declined meetings are easy to spot, and pending invitations are marked.
• One-click Join for Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Jitsi, Kontur Talk and Yandex Telemost. The call link is found in the conference data, the location or the description.
• Meeting card: time, room, organizer, attendees with their replies, and the description with clickable links.
• A reminder with a Join button a couple of minutes before the start.
• Ctrl+Alt+J joins the current meeting from any app.

Nothing to sign in to: it uses the Google account from Settings → Online Accounts. Read-only, no passwords stored, keeps counting down offline.

The copy link button puts the call link on the clipboard; the extension never reads the clipboard.
